summary: the cases of tests/run sealed under etude, against a bootctl that commits a candidate whose trial is still armed, a kernel that checks an ext2 volume at every writable mount, and a disk whose menu does not consume a trial of the fallback entry

argv: { [ -f krffs/recovery_authorized_keys ] || make -s recovery-key; } && sh tests/proofs/guest.sh make rach2-sealed-disk && sh tests/proofs/guest.sh copy ${WORK} rach2/kernel utils/sbin/bootctl && sh tests/proofs/guest.sh exec ${WORK} sh -c 'mtype -i "$ARCH_BUILD/images/rach2-sealed-with-key.disk@@1048576" ::/boot/grub/grub.cfg' > ${WORK}/grub.cfg

faults.name: early-commit
faults.summary: bootctl commit takes an armed trial for one that was consumed

faults.name: always-checked
faults.summary: the kernel checks an ext2 volume at every writable mount, a clean one too

faults.name: fallback-kept
faults.summary: the disk's menu boots a trial of the fallback entry without consuming it, so every later boot takes that entry

edits.find:
set default=fallback
    set next_entry=
    save_env next_entry
